authorization.source: Current user explicitly requests testing warm JVM pooling performance metrics such as latency.
authorization.exception: This supplement expressly permits ONLY the finite non-promoting worker-component comparison below before the broad safety/differential prerequisites of experiment.json. Merely labeling a run diagnostic would not authorize it.
unchanged: Original paired HTTP acceptance protocol, stop rule and thresholds
All safety, full semantic, SQL, selected runtime, cold/sustained/soak and target-host promotion gates
not_authorized: Live runtime reads/mutations or active backend/target rebuild
Promotion or HTTP latency claims from these results

scope.fixture: Exact existing500-node headless module remapped only declared IDs to draft with existing http_setup.draft_module; empty TEXT_ONLY base and empty inventory. Immutable materialized VALIDATE input payload and frame template excluding runtime nonce before runs; candidate/base/inventory/policy and output oracle pinned. Actual DocumentWorker constructs the frame and generates its nonce internally; fixed-field correspondence trusts that pinned production serializer, not an independent pipe capture. This is fresh-ID validation, not accepted-history/SQL work.
scope.fresh_route: Actual new DocumentWorker(DEFAULT).validate with current disabled WarmRuntime; constructor/build identity, existing sandbox/FrameProcess/OwnedWorkerRun cleanup and output serialization included. Actual fresh workers execute in outer control leaf; no invented per-worker cgroup or extra final fence added to baseline.
scope.pool_route: Actual WarmWorkerPool.validate and WarmResultLease.publish, including binding/one-use assumed CLEAN permit, automatic refill, image checks, staging, cleanup, final fence and output serialization. Shared actual ledger and one pool per serial/READY block. No READY wait in primary serial workload.
scope.context: TEST_ASSUMED_CLEAN_CONTEXT_NO_SQL; no PostgreSQL access. Any later SQL work must use SQLeanParser.
scope.comparison: Compares these two actual implemented component policies, including their different isolation costs. Does not identify a causal JVM-prewarming-only effect. Every worker remains single-use.

ready_conditioned.wait: Explicit await actual READY before each admission, with excluded conditioning duration and full cycle duration retained. Never merge with primary serial distribution.

empty_pool.method: New empty pool/ledger incarnation for each request; report initialization, first demand, shutdown, and total separately. Parent JVM and OS caches may be warm. Not server cold-start acceptance.

plan.serial_schedule: Concurrency one, immediately admit next operation after minimal in-memory evidence bookkeeping. No artificial sleep, READY wait, corpus warmup, evidence-file write, full comparator, or expensive group observer between primary samples. Record actual end-to-next-admission gaps. Preserve all warmups; only declared first20 excluded from measured distributions.

measurement.clock: System.nanoTime; store integer nanoseconds. Trusted monotonic-clock model only.
measurement.request_start: Before WorkerCapacity.acquire and all per-request worker construction, binding/permit creation and pool demand; immutable fixture candidate/context payload prepared outside equally for both variants. Pool/ledger initialization is separately timed.
measurement.request_end: After full success response serialization and required actual production cleanup/publication/lease-close and capacity release. No partial-result timing. Failure duration ends after attempted cleanup; retain outcome and do not count it as successful latency.
measurement.fresh_nonce: DocumentWorker generates its private operation nonce internally and checks it. Record returned exact nonce and recovery PID/start/reap; independent fixture response comparison substitutes only each independently checked operation nonce. No claim of independent input-pipe nonce capture.
measurement.pool_observation: Read-only ledger snapshot at admission identifies EMPTY, STARTING or READY. Bind consumed generation by exact request nonce before publication, and require READY-hit identity matches admission snapshot. Count distinct consumed/spare generations, include positive terminal receipts and PID/start absence. No lifecycle mutation or clock injection.
measurement.retention: Retain bounded complete response byte arrays and small observation records in memory; emit evidence only after all request timings and pool teardown. Include retained-buffer cost in whole-scope peak; no response dropping or unbounded queue.
measurement.phase_resources: Whole-scope sampler as existing harness; record cpu.stat before/after measured block and after teardown plus final peak/events, so asynchronous refill and cleanup tail are visible. Peak is for entire variant including warmup and evidence, not per-request RSS.
measurement.statistics: Unrounded nearest-rank p50,p95,p99,max over all100 declared successful measured requests only if every required attempt/response/cleanup passes. Also report attempted/successful counts, all-attempt terminal durations and error counts; any error invalidates performance interpretation. Report each pair separately with paired deltas/ratios. Do not pool runs to hide slow pairs. n100 p99 is descriptive and near the maximum; no confidence interval or production tail claim.
measurement.rate: Measured serial completed operations divided by measurement-wall interval; label serial completion rate, not sustained load capacity. Conditional READY rate includes its separate cycle waits.
measurement.gap: Report admission gaps and conditional wait durations; aggregate CPU/peak include refill/helper work. Timing is instrumented component latency, not HTTP or SQL latency.

safety_and_verification.preflight: Before measured variants, new copied source-bound actual11-case ownership preflight using same production artifacts and full test/program manifest. New fixture compatibility/preflight runs both routes and full response comparator before timing; these preparation samples are not measured.
safety_and_verification.isolation: New privately copied installations and exact delegated user scopes, no live aliases/state/credentials, preserved AppArmor; controller outside scope, all component JVM/helper/refill work inside; no uncontained fallback.
safety_and_verification.response_oracle: Require VALIDATED/BLOCK_SUPPORTED,500 output nodes, exact expected source/hash and closed response schema. Full independent comparator on every retained output against frozen/preflight fresh result with schema-scoped injective generated-ID bijection; independently bind each original nonce before nonce substitution. No status-only oracle. Fresh nonce binding uses the actual production DocumentWorker check plus retained canonical response UUID; pool nonce binding uses the admitted request binding. The fresh input frame is reconstructed for the checker, not independently pipe-captured.
safety_and_verification.frozen_inputs: Before execution bind supplement/Lean/review hashes, exact fixtures, canonical expected source and preflight oracle, Java source/compiled bytes, all Python harness/comparator/verifiers, JDK/tools/default flags, copied runtime inventories, count/order and all scopes. Source changes require new manifest; failed attempts immutable.
safety_and_verification.stop: First operation failure, malformed/mismatched output, timeout, UNKNOWN, resource-limit event, ownership/identity change or cleanup failure stops the variant/suite. Preserve completed and failed rows; mark remaining NOT_EXECUTED. No latency threshold stops this diagnostic and no retries for a favorable result.
safety_and_verification.cleanup: Exact worker recovery/reap receipts plus independent whole-scope positive empty, tracked PID/start absence, direct owner reap, post-input identity and scope removal. Pool generations have their actual ledger terminal group counters. Fresh baseline has no invented per-worker group receipt.
safety_and_verification.trust: Kernel/procfs/cgroup/systemd, pinned JDK/Python/native dependencies, production cleanup adapter receipts, gate observation code, crypto/FS and monotonic clocks trusted. Finite tests do not prove Java/OS refinement.

formal_boundary: Lean supplement models only authorization, disabled selection, diagnostic/promotion distinction, profile classification, finite counts and report accounting/rank arithmetic. No theorem establishes measured latency, resource behavior, SQL CLEAN, code correspondence or timer liveness. Compile before any new Java/Python workload code.

review.require: All six must approve exact final contract hash before workload implementation; blocking findings require refinement.

reporting.required: Raw samples, per-run metrics and pair differences, explicit component/assumed-CLEAN/isolation boundaries, all failed attempts, no positive target-host or HTTP inference.
